goal: Implement the complete pure KMP domain model and contract layer for zones, tray sizes, built-in/user recipes, batches/stages/actions, capacity planning, observations/outcomes, backup-facing snapshots, stable catalog identity/metadata, scheduling and time-zone semantics. Add exhaustive common tests for every assigned domain or catalog surface. Do not implement persistence, platform APIs, Stores, navigation, or UI.
acceptanceCriteria: No Android/iOS, Compose resource, persistence DTO, or UI types enter common domain contracts.
All bundled catalog identities and localization keys are stable and language-neutral.
Capacity, metric area/seed mass, batch state, dependent rescheduling, undo, planner conflict, recurrence/time-zone, and outcome rules are deterministic and boundary-tested.
Fallible manager contracts use one flat Kotlin Result and preserve cancellation/causes.
Every assigned domain-test and catalog-contract-test surface has exact test evidence.
An immutable Protocol 2.0 handoff is produced without editing the delivery ledger.
